value.rationale: The natural contiguous six-length interval begins where squared-cycle maximal cliques stabilize to cyclic triples and ends with the first missing four-vertex faces. It proves the first lower third-homology onset occurs sharply at n=10 and yields complete integral mixed-dimensional homotopy types not entailed by general bounds or one-tolerance classifications. A second geometric transition at n=11 is the full primitive integral generation of H4 by canonical boundaries of unions of disjoint cyclic triangles, with exactly one residual free direction at n=10. These are motivated structural thresholds and complete classifications, not arbitrary digits or a routine normalization test.
